guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows emailservice latency (p90 and p50) and CPU usage spiked by over 36000% and 5800% respectively, with extreme z-scores indicating severe resource exhaustion. Cascading latency increases in checkoutservice and frontend trace errors are direct consequences of this emailservice CPU bottleneck.

proposed_fix.description: Increase CPU limits and requests for emailservice or optimize its processing logic to resolve CPU throttling and restore latency baselines.
